content.text: Cultural buildings are special buildings constructed in castles and tribes that are specific to the county's culture . These correspond to cultural retinues ; the retinue receives the benefit of cultural buildings in the capital holding in addition to its own unique features.
See Combat and the 3 Culture Bonuses for an explanation of how cultural building bonuses can stack with retinue's unique effects, also known as the cultural retinue bonus.
Cultural buildings become inactive (but are not destroyed) if the county's culture changes to one which does not support the cultural building.

content.text: Steppe or desert cultural buildings [2] can only be built on steppe or desert terrain, respectively. They replace the standard barracks and stable, respectively. These buildings are tied to the character's culture - not the province's. If the owner of the county changes to/from a non-steppe culture the buildings are removed (and all investment is lost) - unlike with normal cultural buildings.
All building lines share the same basic requirements as described below (exceptions are noted).
